title: Squirrel wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='76' cy='56' rx='9' ry='18' fill='#f0a24a' transform='rotate(-20 76 56)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#e08a30'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#f7d9a8'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#c06e1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#c06e1f'/>

  <ellipse cx='66' cy='70' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#e08a30' transform='rotate(-20 66 70)'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='18' fill='#e08a30'/>

  <circle cx='33' cy='26' r='5' fill='#c06e1f'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a2415'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a2415'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#8a4a1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q48 51 52 48' stroke='#8a4a1a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M48 8 L38 27 L58 27 Z' fill='#ff4d8d'/>
